hero.title: Meet A-Cube. AI-native, from the metal up.
hero.subtitle: A new architecture for AI, energy-aware at every layer, scaling from coin cell to cloud.

problem.heading: AI isn't a math problem. It's a memory problem.
problem.subtitle: The multiply was never the expensive part. Moving the data was.
problem.stat_description: of a neural net is matrix math. ~75% of the effort is moving it around.

comparison_cards.label: Legacy
comparison_cards.description: Compute and memory sit apart. The chip spends its life shuttling numbers, not crunching them. ~75% of operations are just memory traffic.

comparison_cards.label: A-Cube
comparison_cards.description: We put the compute inside the memory. The commute disappears. Compute where the data lives.

architecture.heading: One architecture that thinks senses, & speaks you language
architecture.subtitle: Three breakthroughs working as one system - a brain that runs on physics, a nervous system that knows when (and how hard) to think, and a language you already speak. Server-class AI in a coin-cell power budget.

pillars.title: CubicCore™
pillars.subtitle: Server-class math. Microwatt power.
pillars.description: It runs the math on physics itself. Ohm's law multiplies, Kirchhoff's law sums - right inside the memory, almost for free. Digital keeps every result exact.
pillars.bullets:
In-memory analog compute - no data commute
~1/100th the energy per operation vs. digital
Scales by replication - tile in more cores, from a smart ring to a server
Fully programmable · 4–32-bit precision, tuned at runtime
Built in standard CMOS - no exotic process

pillars.title: SenseMesh™
pillars.subtitle: Knows when to think - and how hard.
pillars.description: Reflexes in hardware. It fuses every sensor into one clean stream, filters out the noise, and decides - in hardware - when to wake the brain and how much power it needs.
pillars.bullets:
Hardware sensor fusion - no host polling, no firmware overhead
Event-driven wake - compute fires only on real signals
Multimodal by design - motion, audio, vision into one stream
>80% less idle host power vs. legacy MCUs

pillars.title: ModelForge™
pillars.subtitle: No new language to learn.
pillars.description: Bring your own models in TensorFlow, Keras, or ONNX. A push-button compiler does the translation - no rewrites, no proprietary toolchain.
pillars.bullets:
Drop-in support for TensorFlow, Keras, ONNX
Push-button compile - concept to silicon, no rewrites
Speaks matrix math natively — none of the translation tax Arm/RISC-V pay
One workflow that ports across every A-Cube product

modes.heading: Two named modes. One continuous loop.
modes.subtitle: Bridge the lab and real world. The Sparsh module offers continuous, microwatt intelligence in a 21×21mm size,

mode_cards.title: Subconscious AI
mode_cards.bullets: Legacy chips switch off. A-Cube sleeps like you: the brain stays aware. Our island runs AI at microwatts while the ARM core is powered down. Always processing, never draining.

mode_cards.title: Turboboost mode
mode_cards.bullets: When something matters, the brain wakes instantly. The moment SenseMesh flags a real event, runtime DVFS ramps the chip from subconscious idle to full performance

mode_cards.title: SETTLES
mode_cards.bullets: Once the task is completed, the chip settles back into subconscious mode.
